meta.title: Shared browser
meta.description: Turns the DSH Browser tab (right sidebar → Browser) into a desktop browser shared with the agent: back/forward/reload, zoom, find in page, device emulation, history, bookmarks, screenshots, region screenshots, element picking, agent-readable element comments, console/network capture, a DevTools panel (F12), and one-click hand-off of screenshots, elements and logs to the chat draft. The agent drives the very same tab through the bb_* tools (bb_status, bb_open, bb_snapshot, bb_click, …); when a real fingerprint or persistent login is needed the same address can be opened in the local Edge/Chrome over CDP (external channel, ext: tabs) with a live mirror in the sidebar. On Cloudflare-style verification walls the tools tell the agent to stop and leave the check to the user instead of trying to bypass it. The in-app tab still runs in the shell sandbox guest: site permissions, downloads and popups stay denied, and the native DevTools window cannot open in a packaged shell, so the plugin ships its own console/elements/network panel. Disabling the bundle restores the built-in Browser tab and leaves nothing behind.
